title: 🛫 Discover RORA Aguni Airport in MSFS! 🌟
description:
Fly into the scenic beauty of Okinawa with the newly released RORA Aguni Airport for Microsoft Flight Simulator! 🛩️ This detailed add-on features high-resolution satellite imagery, custom ground textures, and a meticulously crafted 800-meter runway. Experience the charm of Aguni Island as you pilot the versatile Cessna 172 Skyhawk, navigating through the realistic airport environment. Whether you’re exploring the rugged volcanic landscape or embarking on a cross-country journey, Aguni Airport offers an immersive experience for all aviation enthusiasts. Don’t miss out on adding this unique airport to your MSFS collection! ✈️✨

For a full overview of new aircrafts and liveries added to the marketplace this week have a look at the video below:
